apt-mark hold clickhouse-client clickhouse-common-static clickhouse-server libpq5 postgresql-18 postgresql-client-18 postgresql-client-common postgresql-common
upgrade_window_steps: Accept a fresh signed-index snapshot and exact DB versions; verify every deb SHA256.
Back up PG and both CH instances; verify compatibility with the installed and rollback SLI releases.
Replace only the approved DB version preferences; explicitly unhold the eight DB packages.
Install all approved DB versions together, verify readback and restore holds before upgrading SLI.
On failure stop the transaction and use the separately accepted recovery procedure; never auto-downgrade.
policy.security_updates: Debian dependencies remain eligible for security updates. DB patches require prompt review and a separate accepted window, not indefinite deferral.
policy.protected_policy: Preserve original vendor deb bytes. Do not rewrite Protected fields. Manual installation plus holds prevents routine autoremove; protection of SLI rollback releases is handled by N10.

negative_cases.expected: Exact version retains priority 990; every other version of the eight packages has priority -1; installed packages remain held.
PGDG/ClickHouse origin priority -1; Debian candidates and OS security updates remain available.
Keep DB holds and exact preferences; never use --allow-change-held-packages or --ignore-hold in the SLI upgrade path.
Installer preflight must abort before unpack. No maintainer script may unhold or run nested apt/dpkg.
APT preferences are not a privilege boundary. An administrator can override versions/holds explicitly; ordinary automation must not do so.
Abort acquisition/install; do not disable signature, hash or Valid-Until checks.

policy.reproducibility_scope: The initial install uses the exact closure below and preserved original debs/indexes. Debian libraries may subsequently receive security updates; only eight DB packages are held. A fresh signed SLI snapshot with Valid-Until is required for distribution; do not disable upstream expiry to reuse this evidence later.

verification.scope: N02 package provenance, required Depends/Pre-Depends closure and hold/pinning policy; no DB runtime, SLI upgrade or physical CPU acceptance.

source.verification_scope: SHA256 and Sigstore signature/certificate/transparency proof; release manager hugo@python.org, GitHub OIDC
